_comment: The AdMob identities the shells are built with. install-ads.mjs writes the
platform's block into the shell's index.html as window.__phaseAds and the
App ID into the Android manifest / iOS Info.plist.
THESE ARE THE OWNER'S LIVE IDS (AdMob publisher 1341622370227647, pasted
5 Sep 2026). testing is false, so a build from this file shows real adverts
and earns real money - and clicking one in your own app is a policy strike.
Put your phone's AdMob test-device id in testDevices to see test adverts on
a live build (Android Studio Logcat prints it the first time an advert
loads, on a line beginning 'Use RequestConfiguration.Builder').
Google's published test ids, for a debug build or a fresh test: App IDs
adaptive banner /9214589741 (Android) and /2435281174 (iOS); rewarded
/5224354917 (Android) and /1712485313 (iOS). Set testing to true with them.
An App ID has a ~ in it; an ad unit ID has a /.
consentDebug forces the EEA consent form on the testDevices phones so the
form can be seen outside Europe.
match-foot IS NEW IN v1.5.0 AND HAS NO UNIT ID YET. The live match screen
carries a banner while play is running (owner, 6 Sep). Both entries are
empty strings on purpose: ads-bridge.js falls back to the home-foot unit
when a place has none, so the slot earns from the first build and simply
reports against the Home unit until two new adaptive-banner units are
created in AdMob and pasted here. Creating them is the owner's job - it
needs the AdMob console - and it is worth doing, because otherwise match
revenue and home revenue are indistinguishable in the reports.
skAdNetworkIds IS GOOGLE'S PARTNER LIST, pasted from
developers.google.com/admob/ios/3p-skadnetworks (page dated 30 Jan 2026,
read 9 Sep 2026). Fifty identifiers, of which the first is Google's own.
install-ads.mjs writes every one into Info.plist. Before this list existed
the plist carried only Google's, and the SDK said so on every launch:
'49 required SKAdNetwork identifier(s) missing from Info.plist'.
An ad network whose identifier is not here cannot be credited for an
install it caused, so its advertisers do not bid on this app. Nothing
breaks and nobody is warned - the adverts are simply worth less. Google
moves this list as partners come and go, so re-read that page now and then
and paste the difference; there is no way to fetch it automatically.
